_README: Seed metadata for the LCT inference backend catalog (STT / LLM / DIARIZATION). Static, benchmark-derived facts that DON'T come from live telemetry: model name, where it runs, empirical speed (RTF / xRealtime) + accuracy (WER vs reference), and cost. The backend_catalog service merges this seed with live per-provider telemetry (observed latency + sample count) and live health probes. Numbers under measured.* come from .tmp/stt_bench (run 2026-05-29) on a 64GB M5 Pro over a 120s mono clip. Accuracy WER is RELATIVE agreement vs the openai-whisper reference (0.0 = matches reference, NOT ground-truth WER). Cloud cost figures are approximate, illustrative, and dated; verify against the provider's current pricing. This file ships in the PUBLIC repo and MUST NOT contain secrets, API keys, or private URLs.
